name: io.github.delta-exchange/delta-exchange-mcp
title: Delta Exchange
description: Official Delta Exchange India MCP server: market data, account reads and order placement.

environmentVariables.name: DELTA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Delta Exchange API key. Optional — market data works without one; set this with DELTA_API_SECRET to enable account reads and trading.

environmentVariables.name: DELTA_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Delta Exchange API secret, paired with DELTA_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: DELTA_MCP_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Which Delta Exchange environment to talk to.
